name: JBAB
description: Joint Base Anacostia-Bolling is an Air Force-led joint installation in Southeast Washington, D.C., hosted by the 11th Wing (Air Force District of Washington). It supports dozens of DoD and federal mission partners in the National Capital Region.

currentNotifications.title: Security Posture — NCR
currentNotifications.body: JBAB operates under elevated security awareness due to proximity to Washington D.C. Expect thorough ID and vehicle checks at all gates.

gates.name: Arnold Gate (Main)
gates.notes: Intersection of Malcolm X Ave SE and MacDill Blvd SE. Hours can change for FPCON/events — confirm on official JBAB visitors page.
gates.address: Malcolm X Ave SE & MacDill Blvd SE, Washington, DC

gates.name: South Gate / Joint Visitor Center
gates.hours: Mon-Thu 0500-2000; Fri 0500-1700; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: Primary visitor processing gate. VCC hours commonly Mon-Fri 0500-1600 (confirm locally). Status see-hours only — no live open/closed promise. Joint Visitor Center desk: 202-284-3555 (confirm hours locally).
gates.address: Chappie James Blvd & Overlook Ave SW, Washington, DC

gates.name: Firth Sterling Gate
gates.hours: Mon-Fri inbound 0630-0830; outbound 0630-0830 and 1500-1700; closed federal holidays and military pass days
gates.notes: Limited rush-hour lanes. Pedestrian turnstiles/bicycle gate noted 24/7 for registered IDs on official visitors page.
gates.address: Firth Sterling Ave SW & Defense Blvd, Washington, DC

resources.name: Furnari Restaurant (Dining Facility)
resources.description: Military-style dining facility on the north side of JBAB (Navy mess hall style). Meal hours commonly published by JBAB PA; confirm before visiting.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Bfast 0600-0900, Lunch 1000-1300, Dinner 1600-1800; Sat-Sun & federal holidays: Brunch 1000-1300, Dinner 1600-1800

resources.name: Slip Inn Waterfront Restaurant
resources.description: Waterfront restaurant at the marina; indoor/outdoor dining. Kitchen typically closes 30 minutes before listed closing.
resources.hours: Tue-Thu 1100-1930; Fri 1100-2030; Sat 1200-1800; Sun 1200-1600; confirm posted hours

resources.name: Burger King
resources.description: Fast food behind the base exchange. Hours from JBAB PA dining guide; confirm locally.
resources.address: Near Main Exchange, Chappie James Blvd, Washington, DC 20032

resources.name: Subway
resources.description: Sub sandwiches on JBAB. Hours from JBAB PA dining guide.

resources.name: Starbucks
resources.description: Coffeehouse next to the commissary.
resources.address: Near Commissary, Chappie James Blvd, Washington, DC 20032

resources.name: Potomac Lanes Snack Bar
resources.description: Snack bar at the bowling center.

resources.name: JBAB Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: AAFES main exchange with food court and retail. Community directory hours; confirm on Exchange site.
resources.address: 195 Chappie James Blvd, Bldg 4514, Washington, DC 20032

resources.name: Bolling JBA Commissary
resources.description: DeCA commissary with CLICK2GO curbside. Official DeCA store listing.

resources.name: Bolling Medical Squadron / JBAB Clinic
resources.description: On-base medical clinic. Use NCR appointment line for scheduling. Unofficial community framing — confirm on TRICARE site.

resources.name: JBAB Pharmacy (Prescription Activation)
resources.description: On-base pharmacy prescription activation lines from JBAB phone directory.

resources.name: Aerobics Center
resources.description: Group fitness / aerobics facility.

resources.name: JBAB Pool
resources.description: Base pool; seasonal/posted hours apply.

resources.name: 11th Wing Finance

resources.description: ID cards, DEERS, personnel actions. Confirm appointment requirements.

resources.description: MWR, family programs, dining, fitness, and recreation. Community FSS site.

resources.description: Relocation, deployment, financial readiness, EFMP, and family programs.
resources.hours: Commonly M-F daytime; confirm before visiting

resources.hours: Front desk 24/7 typical for lodges; confirm

resources.description: Outdoor recreation and marina services.

resources.description: Bowling center with snack bar.

resources.name: Youth Center
resources.description: Youth programs and school-age care.

resources.name: Stewart Education Center

resources.name: Joint Visitor Control Center
resources.description: Visitor passes and base access processing. Sponsor required. REAL ID / passport typically required. Hours commonly Mon-Fri ~0500-1600; closed weekends — confirm on official visitors page. Status is see-hours only.
resources.hours: Commonly Mon-Fri 0500-1600; closed weekends & holidays — confirm locally

resources.name: 11th Security Forces Squadron (BDOC)
resources.description: Base defense / law enforcement. For emergencies use 911 or Fire/EMS crisis line; BDOC for police desk.

events.title: EFMP “Walk & Roll”
events.description: Location: MPF Field Join us for the EFMP “Walk & Roll” with an Interactive Family Fair! A Community event honoring military families with special needs and celebration inclusion, resilience, and support. The walk and roll promote awareness of EFMP resources and strengthens connections across our community. We aim to partner with Exceptional Family Member Program from all branches of service to share resources, amplify impact and stand united. Together, we walk to support, inform and empower EFM Families.

sections.title: Installation overview
sections.body: Joint Base Anacostia-Bolling is in Southeast Washington, D.C. Host wing is the 11th Wing. Use MilitaryINSTALLATIONS for check-in procedures and current contacts.

sections.title: Military & Family Readiness
sections.body: Relocation and family readiness support at 118 Brookley Avenue, Bldg 13. Hours commonly M-F 0800-1530; confirm before visiting.
